name: Balance Adjustment Type 1 Code
definition: Defines the type of allowed balance adjustment.

LDGR.name: Ledger
LDGR.definition: Adjustment applies to the average ledger (book) balance.

FLOT.name: Float
FLOT.definition: Adjustment applies to the average float (unavailable) balance.

CLLD.name: Collected
CLLD.definition: Adjustment applies to the average collected (book less float) balance.
